params.mask_rule: A kerb tile sits on a raised cell (pavement, cobbles or grass) that has a road cell among its 8 neighbours. Bit set = that neighbour is NOT road (out of map counts as not road); a clear edge bit is a kerb on that edge. A corner bit counts only when both adjacent edge bits are set (a clear corner with both edges set is an inner corner). blob_masks[i] is the reduced mask drawn by frame tile.kerb:blob:-:i, ascending; 255 (index 46, no road neighbour) is never written by the compiler, which writes autotile 255 instead.
